title.zh: DINO-WM：我的世界模型入门笔记
title.en: DINO-WM: My first notes on world models

summary.zh: 从预训练视觉特征到动作规划，尽量不借助数学公式，读懂 DINO-WM 的思路与方法。
summary.en: From pretrained visual features to action planning: making sense of DINO-WM, with as little math as possible.

title.zh: Newt：多任务世界模型阅读笔记
title.en: Newt: Reading notes on multitask world models

summary.zh: 从专家示范预训练到在线交互，记录 Newt 如何在潜在空间学习动力学、奖励与价值，并与 DINO-WM 作比较。
summary.en: From demonstration pretraining to online interaction: how Newt learns latent dynamics, rewards, and values, and how it compares with DINO-WM.
